- distribution: multi-channel reach across general trade, modern trade and digital/quick-commerce — evidence: strengthened digital and omnichannel presence across e-commerce and quick-commerce platforms including Blinkit, Swiggy Instamart and Zepto, complementing the general trade, modern trade and organised retail network
- brand: multi-brand portfolio spanning men's, women's and children's categories with a premium sub-brand — evidence: portfolio comprises VIP, Frenchie, Frenchie X, Feelings, Leader, Rivolta and Yuwa Series, with Frenchie X expanded as a premium men's innerwear range during the year
bull_bear.title: Bull — competitive strengths

bull_bear.body:
- Raw-material and cost risk — Changes in prices and availability of yarn, fabric, chemicals, packaging, energy and freight may affect gross margins.
- Market and competition risk — The business operates in a competitive market with organised, unorganised and digital-first participants.
- Demand, product and inventory risk — Changes in consumer preferences, seasonality, discounting and inaccurate demand forecasts may lead to lost sales or ageing inventory.
- Credit and channel risk — The Company's distribution model may expose it to receivable delays, counterparty stress and channel inventory.
- Operational and supply-chain risk — Manufacturing interruption, vendor failure, logistics disruption or quality issues may affect availability and customer service.
- Technology and cybersecurity risk — Greater reliance on enterprise and digital systems increases exposure to outages, cyber incidents and loss or misuse of data.
- Regulatory and compliance risk — The Company is subject to corporate, securities, tax, labour, environmental, consumer, product and data-related requirements.
- People and execution risk — Growth depends on attracting, developing and retaining skilled employees and executing strategic initiatives effectively.
